Completed voluntarily with substantial general JavaScript codecs and native geometry algorithms; no evidence of canned answers or hidden-test access. Eighteen passing test groups, 87 schema types, a 54-entity shared-edge cube assembly and byte-identical CLI normalization are corroborated. A malformed-number self-test was correctly rebuilt with valid physical line widths. Legal trailing comments preserve generic bool/int and empty/defaulted distinctions; external consumers may ignore those hints. Third-party CAD corpus validation remains honestly unverified. Original grading 259/261 included one real 0H reader defect and one false negative from an invalid empty Face510 prerequisite. The independently reviewed 1.0.18 tests-only repair uses a legal triangular open-shell context and directly observes both Face boolean encodings, while permitting defaults and trailing comments. Reference and mutation checks support the repair. Official regrading is 260/261, with only the 0H reader failure remaining; submitted source and model-visible inputs are unchanged. Preserve original 259/261 as historical evidence and publish current 260/261 with this remaining defect and coverage limits. Root verified source/result preservation, current committed rubric and unchanged prompt, pinned grader image 9a4f1fe, 261 unique cases and exactly one repaired test outcome. Full session accounting matches 41 underlying tool calls and 23,051 reasoning tokens; the original $8.583752 API-equivalent estimate is unchanged. No new generation calls were made by regrading.
